profile: Pediatrix Medical Group provides physician services in newborn, maternal-fetal, and other pediatric subspecialty care through affiliated clinicians. Its neonatal teams care for premature or medically complicated babies, primarily in hospital neonatal intensive care units. Maternal-fetal clinicians provide inpatient and office-based care to expectant mothers with complicated pregnancies and their unborn babies. The network also includes pediatric intensivists, hospitalists, and surgeons serving hospital clients and patients.
